title: Herrera spoke to Kirk McConnell in a SCIF

tellings.quote: I know. I know. I talked to him in a skiff.

plain: Michael Herrera says he spoke with a man named Kirk McConnell in person, inside a SCIF, a sealed room in Washington used for talking about classified information. Herrera, who says on the show that he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, gives this as his own experience, saying simply "I talked to him in a skiff." He mentions it to show that he has been heard by people with security clearances.
